avengers.title: Marvel Avengers Dataset
avengers.description: Contains characteristics of Marvel Avengers characters including powers, appearances, and comic book history.
avengers.sample_exercise_code:
# Count characters by gender
df['gender'].value_counts()

# Find most common powers
powers = ['has_super_strength', 'has_flight']
df[powers].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
example_questions: Which gender has more super strength?
Is there correlation between introduction year and appearances?

majors.title: College Majors Analysis
majors.description: Employment data for recent college graduates by major, including median salaries and unemployment rates.
majors.sample_exercise_code:
# Find top 5 highest paying majors
df.nlargest(5, 'median_salary')[['major', 'median_salary']]

# Compare unemployment by category
df.groupby('major_category')['unemployed'].mean().sort_values()
example_questions: Which major category has the lowest unemployment?
What's the salary distribution across categories?

lyrics.title: Hip-Hop Lyrics Analysis
lyrics.description: Over 10,000 hip-hop lyrics with metadata including artist, year, and sentiment scores.
lyrics.sample_exercise_code:
# Find most frequent words
from collections import Counter
words = ' '.join(df['lyrics']).split()
Counter(words).most_common(20)

# Track sentiment over time
df.groupby('year')['sentiment_score'].mean().plot()
example_questions: How has lyrical sentiment changed over time?
Which artists use the most explicit language?

masculinity.title: Masculinity Survey Results
masculinity.description: Survey data on American men's attitudes about masculinity from Pew Research Center.
masculinity.sample_exercise_code:
# Compare pressure by age group
df.groupby('age_group')['feels_pressure_to_be_masculine'].mean().sort_values()

# Cross-tab education vs comfort with emotions
pd.crosstab(df['education'], df['comfort_level_with_emotions'])
example_questions: Does income affect feelings about masculinity?
How do education levels correlate with emotional comfort?
